test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd man out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option (1): OXG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52b491897e48d08ad532e8bc89614d250a6b68a4e655149120824f563f2ad88b.png] 

**Option (2): AJS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdeeabae171e294814dd631a2c585e203bd0d85827431e3406b8bedcd7c66a1d.png] 

**Option (3): VEM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8bdec78fda7955ac165475e8fd83378102ad38c9dc74168d75e6359fe10f80b.png] 

**Option (4): KTC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dee757c4494fafe77c0dcda07e98c12a718509d414f64d8974fbf90a5817c09.png] 

 

Options (1), (2), and (4) follow the pattern of "add 9, then add 9".

However, option (3) follows a different pattern of "add 9, then add 8".

The letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to the group is: **VEM**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)"**
